displayName: Native shell with NativeScript UI islands
statusNote: The native shell owns List, Selection, navigation, state, persistence and stream processing. One NativeScript V8 runtime renders Detail and Insights with @nativescript/core views and calls the host's Kotlin directly. iOS embedding (NativeScriptEmbedder in the UIKit host) is not implemented yet.

android.uiToolkit: Jetpack Compose shell; NativeScript core Detail and Insights islands
android.runtime: ART native shell plus one lazy or prewarmed NativeScript V8 runtime
android.streamClient: native in-app replay of the bundled, golden-verified stream; WebSocket not implemented

R1.note: The Insights island is embedded in the installed artifact.

R2.reason: Independently delivered island JavaScript is not implemented.

sync.note: Host-to-island messages go through a JavaScript-implemented Handler.Callback and markers / draw probes call IslandBenchApi, all synchronously on the main thread; the bridge micro-benchmark is not implemented.

async.reason: Only the island's ready message is deferred by one main-loop turn.

crossRuntime.boundary: native host owns data and navigation; NativeScript renders Detail and Insights from versioned JSON messages

deviations.description: The native host marker core is candidate-local interim instrumentation; island markers call it directly.
deviations.impact: Results remain descriptive until the shared calibrated BenchKit and overhead experiment exist.

deviations.description: The native host replays the same golden-verified bundled stream on the absolute monotonic schedule.
deviations.impact: It compares only inside replay transport cells and is never pooled with server transport.

deviations.description: The NativeScript CLI generates the Android project, which is built on Gradle 9.3.1 / AGP 9.1.0 like the other island hosts instead of the runtime template's Gradle 8.14.3 / AGP 8.12.1, with two compatibility edits (scripts/build-android.sh).
deviations.impact: The shared host compiles against the same AndroidX and Compose versions as the other island candidates.

deviations.description: The NativeScript runtime library manifest merges storage and phone-state permissions into the APK.
deviations.impact: Declared only; the app never requests them.
